name: Motor underload process alarm
summary: Indicates a low-load condition used by the assigned process-monitoring function.
description: Indicates a low-load condition used by the assigned process-monitoring function. A motor feeder combines switching, motor protection and an operating command. Starting permission, running feedback and protection trip are different signals even where one relay or controller processes all of them.

In a switchroom motor-control panel, a ventilation motor can receive an automatic start request while a local selector and the motor protection determine whether the feeder is available. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Measured motor load” at the input and “Underload alarm” at the output. Low load has application-specific meaning.
